values.goal: Produce one transactional C-SDLC v3 lifecycle-kernel slice.
values.required_outcome: A transactional, non-authoritative C-SDLC v3 lifecycle-kernel slice with capability-checked transitions, atomic modeled commits, recovery replay, typed adapters, crate-local AGENTS.md guidance, and focused failure-injection proof for retained requirements #168 through #170.
authority_boundary: C-SDLC v2 remains the sole operational lifecycle authority throughout #502.
Issue completion is exactly delivery of one transactional lifecycle-kernel slice; storage, adapters, tests, and crate-local guidance are inseparable implementation parts.
The #502 slice is non-authoritative and must not perform live lifecycle writes, GitHub mutation, publication, finish, cleanup, v2 migration, or authority cutover.
initial_assumptions: #501 is published/reviewed and remains the stack base until it merges.
The crate-local AGENTS.md is guidance only and remains subordinate to root AGENTS.md.
operator_constraints: Execute #502 after #501 is published/reviewed and keep final #502 integration ordered behind #501.
Stack #502 on the #501 branch while #501 is not yet merged to main.
Do not modify C-SDLC v2 behavior or authority.
Do not start V3-D or later implementation inside this issue.
Keep issue-start mechanics simple enough that a prepared issue can be inspected, bound, and started quickly without bypassing typed v2 authority.
